verdict.rationale: Sketch's AI feature 'Build' claims to take any frame and build it out in code with 1:1 visual fidelity, and developer handoff lets devs inspect specs in-browser without needing Mac/Sketch app, which supports shipping code from designs. However, evidence is vendor-authored marketing copy with no independent verification of code quality, output format (React/HTML/CSS?), or fidelity claims, and no component-to-code mapping system (e.g., mapping design components to existing codebase components) is documented beyond a generic 'recreate... inside Sketch' AI feature that goes code-to-design, not design-to-code. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of code output quality and shippability, clarity on which frameworks/languages are supported, evidence of persistent component-to-code mapping (not just one-off frame export), and any developer testimonials confirming the code is production-ready.
